measurement_notes.cold: one OS process per measurement: interpreter start-up + import duckdb + fresh read-only database open + the work. This is the shape the 7.60 s total in the evaluation section was measured in.
measurement_notes.warm: work only: chk imported once, one read-only duckdb connection per cluster held open, median over repeats.
measurement_notes.answering_query: the SQL the certificate certifies, run on the same warehouse. The 15 refusal certificates have no answering query: recorded as null, never as zero.
measurement_notes.prop_5_11_scope: Prop 5.11 bounds the in-window probe term of Chk by the answering query and bounds the governance-table term by |C| and the gov_* table sizes instead. An end-to-end wall-clock ratio > 1 is the deployment tax, not a counterexample. Prop 5.11's full-scan escape hatch (the whole-marking-set symdiff_audit of the retired track) has NO instance in this corpus: the only clause-(iv) audits here are the window-restricted window_realization_symdiff on CARD-Q2, CARD-Q7 and EF2-Q6. That is now MEASURED, not asserted -- impl/measure_adm_scan.py -> impl/adm_scan_p2.json replays each audit through chk.p2_realization_days and reports window_bounded=true for all three (realised days per anchor 30/30, 28/28, 1/0 against request windows of 30, 28 and 1 days, versus 451, 451 and 1891 markers a whole-marking-set audit would scan). No timing in THIS file was re-run for that measurement.

aggregate.percentile_method: nearest-rank, index = ceil(p*n) - 1 over the sorted sample
